item.title: The Lynceus pulled a folded lead tablet out of a child's grave in Pagasae & the Agora: Ant
item.description: The Lynceus pulled a folded lead tablet out of a child's grave in Pagasae & the Agora: Antimkles #2638 had written Phaiddotos #9888's name on it, with the words "I bind Phaiddotos #9888, the tongue, the hands, the work".
